definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese dish of lightly coated tofu that is deep-fried until crispy on the outside, then served in a warm dashi-based broth with toppings such as grated daikon and green onion.

examples.japanese: {揚|あ}げ{出|だ}し{豆腐|どうふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{揚|あ}げ{出|だ}し{豆腐|どうふ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧カリカリだ。
examples.english: The agedashi tofu at this restaurant is crispy on the outside.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{揚|あ}げ{出|だ}し{豆腐|どうふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{片栗粉|かたくりこ}→片栗粉：04923_katakuriko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まぶして→まぶす：18477_mabusu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{揚|あ}げる→揚げる：16879_ageru⟧。
examples.english: When making agedashi tofu at home, you coat it in potato starch before frying.

notes:
A staple of Japanese home cooking and izakaya menus. The tofu is coated in ⟦{片栗粉|かたくりこ}→片栗粉：04923_katakuriko⟧ (potato starch) or ⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧ (wheat flour), deep-fried briefly, and served in a light ⟦{出汁|だし}→出汁：04917_dashi⟧-based sauce seasoned with ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧ and ⟦{味醂|みりん}→味醂：04918_mirin⟧.

COMMON TOPPINGS:
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}おろし→大根おろし：26890_daikonoroshi⟧: grated daikon radish
- {刻|きざ}みネギ: chopped green onion
- おろし⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧: grated ginger
- ⟦{鰹節|かつおぶし}→鰹節：04935_katsuobushi⟧: bonito flakes

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {揚|あ}げ{出|だ}し{豆腐|どうふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make agedashi tofu
- {揚|あ}げ{出|だ}し{豆腐|どうふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧: to order agedashi tofu
